title: Sessions know their session id and how to read, answer and send coord asks
goal: the coord hook's SessionStart output names the session's own id and how to read, answer (kbask.py answer ID) and send (kbask.py ask TARGET) coord asks, through redact.redact and within its line budget; the worker brief and the worker role file tell a worker to answer asks addressed to its item; the kb-sprint run step says to steer a running worker or runner with kbask.py ask instead of stopping it or starting a second session; kb/_self/monitoring.md and kb/_self/tools.md say so

import sys
def _fail(t, e, tb, _d=sys.excepthook):
    if issubclass(t, AssertionError):
        print('check failed:', e); sys.exit(1)
    _d(t, e, tb)
sys.excepthook = _fail
import os, subprocess, tempfile, json
T = tempfile.mkdtemp(); sid = '-'.join(c * n for c, n in (('1', 8), ('2', 4), ('3', 4), ('4', 4), ('5', 12)))
env = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith('KB_COORD')}
env.update(KB_COORD_STORE=os.path.join(T, 'c.sqlite'), NO_COLOR='1')
ev = json.dumps({'hook_event_name': 'SessionStart', 'source': 'startup', 'session_id': sid, 'cwd': os.getcwd(), 'transcript_path': os.path.join(T, 't.jsonl')})
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '.claude/hooks/coord_hook.py'], input=ev, capture_output=True, text=True, env=env, timeout=60)
out = p.stdout + p.stderr
print(out[-600:])
miss = [w for w in (sid, 'kbask.py ask', 'kbask.py answer') if w not in out]
print('missing from the SessionStart output:', miss)
sys.exit(1 if miss else 0)
